play.goal: (() => { const qs = state.quests || []; const q = qs.find((x) => x.tracked) || qs.find((x) => x.state === 'active'); return q ? q.title + (q.need ? ' (' + q.have + '/' + q.need + ')' : '') : null; })()
play.brief: Embervale: an open-world pixel RPG (think Skyrim in pixels). Distances are in tiles. Hostile creatures and bandits fight back; wolves wind up before they bite (the autopilot rolls away from telegraphed attacks). People can be talked to; dialogue options are picked with choose N. Quests appear in the goal line.
